name: Moneyline by season margin
hypothesis: Team with the higher official season margin wins more often than its moneyline price implies
note: Margin is an outcome measure; the hypothesis needs an out-of-sample test (see SIG13 pre-registration)

name: Spread by margin-implied line
hypothesis: Margin-implied spread beats posted spread after vig

name: Game total by pace and points
hypothesis: Combined PTS and implied opponent points predict totals better than the posted line

name: Moneyline by prior-season win rate
hypothesis: Last season's final win rate carries information into this season's results

name: Two-leg same-game moneyline and total
hypothesis: Positive dependence between a team moneyline and game total is mispriced
note: Requires measured leg correlation with a priced sample (G7)

name: Two-leg cross-game moneylines
note: Requires priced sample and independence test (G7)

name: Player points over with team moneyline
hypothesis: Star scoring nights correlate with team win probability
note: Exploratory correlation only (n=14 Edwards rows; see Correlations)

name: Same-player points over with rebounds over
hypothesis: Same-player stat correlation makes this parlay underpriced
note: Exploratory r computed from 14 rows of one player; not a population estimate

name: Same-player under parlay (points, rebounds, assists unders)
hypothesis: Under legs on one player are correlated through minutes; the book prices them as independent
note: Blocked only if the reported 2026-27 NBA memo is confirmed on an official page (F06)

name: Under bet on a player expected under 12 minutes
hypothesis: Low-minute players produce under results more often than priced
note: Blocked only if confirmed (F06); minutes expectation is not an official field

name: First-of market (first basket or first rebound)
